snippet.title: The Beacon's End - A short PSX / VHS-style horror game!
snippet.description:
Download for free on itch.io https://capcrowgames.itch.io/the-beacons-end?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt You play as Samuel, a solitary lighthouse keeper on the remote Blackstone island. Tasked with a daily routine trying to forget his haunting past by maintaining the lighthouse beacon to protect passing ships, Samuel is unaware that underneath the island lurks something very sinister.The Beacon's End is a game attempting to recreate the atmosphere of  classic PSX horror games and visuals.
